text:
megan: quick design check — I pushed an updated role-map prototype. two things I want eyes on: 1) collapsed vs stacked role rows in small screens, 2) SSO toggle placement in the invite modal (inline vs settings banner). screenshot: https://img.redwood/proto/rolemap-v4.png :eyes: ryan: saw it, love the compact row but worried about discoverability when collapsed. can we add a chevron + tooltip on hover that reads ‘show role details’? megan: yup — thinking tooltip + aria-expanded state. on mobile the chevron would expand an inline panel instead of a flyout. kai: implementation note — expanding inline panel will affect audit log event shapes (we currently log role_id but not the expanded_view boolean). if we add expansion state we should log it for analytics. also perf: collapsing should be pure css height toggle to avoid re-rendering big lists. olivia: accessibility nits: tooltip needs a keyboard focus target and an accessible name. also, when collapsed the role rows must still expose permission summaries to screen readers. suggestion: add an offscreen summary like `aria-hidden=false` only for SR that says "View role: Admin — can deploy, manage models" ryan: copy tweak for SSO toggle confirm — current mock shows: "Require SSO for org?" Can we change to: "Require Single Sign-On for all members?" then confirm button: "Enable SSO for this org" and secondary: "Ask to enable later" — fewer ambiguous words. megan: that reads clearer. also debating placement: inline in invite modal (right below email input) vs banner at top of org settings. pros: inline = clearer at invite time; cons: could confuse admins who manage SSO globally. kai: infra-wise inline toggle would need to call the settings write endpoint if turned on. that's fine but we should warn about tenancy effects (disabling local invites). we should surface a tooltip: "Enabling SSO will disable password sign-in for new users". olivia: small accessibility flag: any modal-level change to org auth should surface a confirmation dialog with clear focus trap and an explanation paragraph. Make the paragraph simple, avoid jargon like "tenant" or "provisioning". megan: agreed. can we finalize the microcopy now? Ryan, can you post the exact strings you want in the mock? ryan: sure — propose these strings: - Inline label: "Require Single Sign-On (SSO)" - Short helper: "When enabled, new and existing members must authenticate via your SSO provider." - Confirm heading: "Enable SSO for this organization" - Confirm body: "This will enforce SSO for all members and may change how users sign in. You can manage provider settings in Settings → Security." - Confirm primary CTA: "Enable SSO" - Confirm secondary: "Cancel — review settings" kai: implementation snippet for aria states I would add to the role chevron button in the prototype (rough): ```html
…permissions…
``` olivia: +1 to the snippet, but change `hidden` usage to manage with `aria-hidden` so SRs get updated: set `aria-hidden=\"true\"` and toggle to `false` on expand, then remove `hidden` attr only after animation finishes. deploy-bot: preview deploy available at https://preview.redwood/rolemap-v4 (build: rolemap-v4-2026-03-22) :rocket: megan: thanks — next steps: Ryan will update mock copy and add tooltip text; Kai will add analytics event for expansion and wire up aria changes; Olivia will add a small SR copy for collapsed summary; I'll push a quick follow-up PR to the invite modal so we can test in the preview. :100: ryan: will do, aiming to post updated frames by EOD PST. kai: i'll add a small server-side flag for the expansion event and a perf note in the PR. olivia: i'll write the SR copy and test with VoiceOver. megan: great — thanks all!" }
